answer: The forge test I would run is Signed golf handicap certificate with golf union attestation: a handicap the union tracked across rounds and courses, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the kernel compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The walnut grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
